catalog.archive_scope: Complete official DejaGNU 1.6.3 source release including framework, board files, tests, manuals and per-file licenses.
catalog.container_strategy: Extract the verified archive into the dev source-material prefix. Keep this source-only reference separate from the apt.dejagnu executable; preserve Tcl/Expect version and board/site.exp identities in run contexts.
catalog.purpose: Pinned implementation and reference material for DejaGNU board integration, summary parsing and regression-harness debugging; the runnable harness remains the separately locked apt.dejagnu package.
qualification_gaps: Reference material only; source presence does not install or qualify a second DejaGNU harness.
The parser was checked against framework.exp and runtest.exp plus synthetic fixtures; no full GCC regression run was executed.
catalog.size_basis: Measured complete archive bytes and SHA256; source logical bytes sum all regular tar entries, excluding filesystem allocation and build or installed sizes.
